Class LocalEncryptedSecretManagerImpl

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.security.secrets.local.LocalEncryptedSecretManagerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
SecretManager, LocalEncryptedSecretManager
@ApplicationScoped public class LocalEncryptedSecretManagerImpl extends Object implements LocalEncryptedSecretManager
Local encrypted storage implementation of SecretManager. Features: - File-based storage with AES-256 encryption - Suitable for development and standalone deployment - No external dependencies - Fast startup NOT RECOMMENDED for production environments.
